title: Bug: derlen size_t to word32 cast without overflow guard
description: In wp11_backend_soft.c, wp11_soft_key_new_from_der() casts the size_t derlen parameter to word32 without checking for overflow (size_t > UINT32_MAX). The rest of the codebase applies this guard consistently (e.g., wp11_keystore.c). On 64-bit platforms with a DER blob larger than 4 GiB this would silently truncate. Fix: add a guard 'if (derlen > (size_t)UINT32_MAX) return NULL;' before the cast, consistent with the pattern used elsewhere.
